anti-inflammatory.description: Secreted mediators that dampen innate inflammation and protease-driven tissue damage (ST-266 / amnion secretome literature).

neuroprotective.description: Growth factors and guidance cues linked to RGC / CNS protection in published ST-266 and AMP-cell secretome studies.

anti-apoptotic.description: Soluble receptors, TIMPs and survival factors reported in AMP-cell secretome / anti-apoptotic pathway annotations.
